title: Thai-Style Mung Bean Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired stir fry made with mung beans, unique sprouts, and light Irish pasta. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the Irish pasta according to package instructions.
Rinse and drain the mung beans, then soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the mung beans again, then add them to the pot with 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the mung beans are tender.
Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and chili flakes and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the bean sprouts, soy sauce, and fish-free sauce, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Add the cooked mung beans and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the cooked Irish pasta and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
